about: The HTTP routes of the Smart Graph and of the Nuclear Developer.

rows.title: `POST /developer/analyze` — the Nuclear Developer's HTTP API
rows.summary: Runs the local analyst on one request: `analyze(input: AnalyzeRequest) Analysis`. The Developer listens on `127.0.0.1:7879`.
body: `POST /developer/analyze` → `analyze(input: AnalyzeRequest) Analysis`.
Each request runs on a thread of its own, so nothing of one request reaches the next. Start it: `nuclear-developer` (or `dragonfly run` in its folder).

rows.title: `DELETE /v1/documents/{collection}/{doc_id}` — the Smart Graph's HTTP API
rows.summary: Removes what an agent kept at run time (`memory`, `examples`).
body: Removes what an agent kept at run time (`memory`, `examples`).
Scope: `write`. The graph listens on `127.0.0.1:7878` only; every route but the health and the access request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

rows.title: `GET /v1/access` — the Smart Graph's HTTP API
rows.summary: The pending access requests and the allowed clients.
body: The pending access requests and the allowed clients.

rows.title: `POST /v1/applies` — the Smart Graph's HTTP API
rows.summary: What of a spec or a task is not possible yet or was never run for real: the capabilities rows whose `triggers` the text writes, for its platform: `{text, platform}` answers `{items: [{id, type, title, summary, trigger}]}`.
body: What of a spec or a task is not possible yet or was never run for real: the capabilities rows whose `triggers` the text writes, for its platform: `{text, platform}` answers `{items: [{id, type, title, summary, trigger}]}`. Exact, never by meaning.
Scope: `read`. The graph listens on `127.0.0.1:7878` only; every route but the health and the access request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

rows.title: `POST /v1/documents` — the Smart Graph's HTTP API
rows.summary: Keeps what an agent learned at run time: a note about a project (`memory`) or a solved example (`examples`).
body: Keeps what an agent learned at run time: a note about a project (`memory`) or a solved example (`examples`). The rows of the knowledge base are written only by ingest; these survive it.
Scope: `write`. The graph listens on `127.0.0.1:7878` only; every route but the health and the access request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

rows.title: `POST /v1/ingest` — the Smart Graph's HTTP API
rows.summary: Makes the knowledge base folder `roots[0]` what the graph knows; only what changed is embedded again.
body: Makes the knowledge base folder `roots[0]` what the graph knows; only what changed is embedded again.
Scope: `admin`. The graph listens on `127.0.0.1:7878` only; every route but the health and the access request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

rows.title: `POST /v1/search` — the Smart Graph's HTTP API
rows.summary: Searches the graph by meaning and by exact name: `{query, collection | shelves, k, platform, agents, where, expand}` answers `{items: [{id, shelf, text, meta, distance, score, via, card, related}]}`.
body: Searches the graph by meaning and by exact name: `{query, collection | shelves, k, platform, agents, where, expand}` answers `{items: [{id, shelf, text, meta, distance, score, via, card, related}]}`. Without a collection it searches every shelf of the knowledge base.
Scope: `read`. The graph listens on `127.0.0.1:7878` only; every route but the health and the access request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

rows.title: `POST /v1/strategy` — the Smart Graph's HTTP API
rows.summary: The strategy of a request: which kind of request it is (a whole system, one screen, a rename, a failing test...) and the plan of that kind.
body: The strategy of a request: which kind of request it is (a whole system, one screen, a rename, a failing test...) and the plan of that kind. `{text, platform, existing, new}` answers `{items: [{id, title, summary, score, why, data, text}]}`, best first, at most three. By the request's exact signs first, then by meaning.
Scope: `read`. The graph listens on `127.0.0.1:7878` only; every route but the health and the access request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
